rules.status_semantics: REUSED_ACCEPTED_EVIDENCE means: the named accepted scope, on the named candidate bytes, as ruled by the named CTO record. It is NOT a hosted-CI PASS and NOT a claim that every node of the file ran. Ordinary-zone CI results are reported separately and are never merged into these scopes.
rules.gap_semantics: GAP entries mark what the accepted receipts cannot prove (per-node mapping, hosted re-execution). GAPs stay open until the CTO defines a finite repair scope; author PASS claims are not copied as independent acceptance.
rules.invalidation: Historical candidates, XML/node maps and load_bearing_blobs retain their original provenance; they are not current-byte or fresh-run claims. Current source authority is the tool-fixed CTO intake ref, compared independently against every backend/frontend path, byte and Git mode plus the three external paths. Any unapproved drift or coverage-only provenance change refuses. Current attachment deltas remain explicitly unrerun GAPs; all_valid is bounded admission, never release_ready/evidence_ready.
rules.historical_documents: historical_source_documents retain original source blobs only; normal governance-document updates are not live product-freeze failures
